items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: You know his brother, the one player guitar died, Sam Casimir. When did he die? Oh, about three months ago somebody told me.

ctx.x: You know his brother, the one player guitar died, Sam Casimir. When did he die? Oh, about three months ago somebody told me. He died in Chicago. And they was all playing back there with Henry Harden's band, at the rhythm club. Then afterwards he beat it, then Joe got in there. Joe had killed him.
